biggest_catch: There is NO fixed signup bonus right now — Discover's savings bonuses ($150/$200) were discontinued (confirmed Oct 2025), so the only 'payout' is variable interest (~3.30% APY) that Discover can change at any time. This is a savings account, not a bonus.
catches: No current fixed-dollar signup bonus: the historical $150/$200 savings bonuses required $15,000+ deposits and are no longer offered (NerdWallet editor's note, Oct 15, 2025: 'Discover Bank's savings bonuses are no longer available. This page will be updated when a new offer is available.').
The APY is variable and can change before or after you open the account — Discover's own disclosure states the advertised APY is only 'accurate as of' a stated date.
Interest is not a bonus: on a $1,000 balance at 3.30% APY you earn roughly $33 in a year — real money, but slow and proportional to your balance.
No minimum deposit to open and no monthly fees, but you must fund the account with your own money; external transfer times (1-3 business days) apply.
FDIC insurance covers up to $250,000 per depositor, per insured bank, per ownership category — balances above that at Discover Bank are not covered.
Discover Bank is now part of Capital One (acquisition closed 2025); deposit-agreement terms have been updated accordingly — confirm current terms before opening.
Online-only account: no branches; customer service is 24/7 by phone/app.

steps: Go to discover.com and open a Discover Online Savings Account online or by phone (no minimum deposit to open, $0 monthly fee).
Fund the account via ACH transfer from your existing bank (allow 1-3 business days for the transfer to post).
Your balance earns the current variable APY (recently ~3.30%), compounded daily and credited monthly — read the live rate on discover.com at signup since it changes.
There is no bonus to chase right now: do not expect a fixed signup payout; your earnings are purely the interest on your balance.
Keep balances within FDIC limits ($250,000 per depositor, per ownership category at Discover Bank) if your balance is large.
Re-check discover.com periodically — if Discover relaunches a fixed savings bonus, it becomes a separate, concrete payout worth acting on.
timing: Interest compounds daily, credited monthly. No bonus payout exists — earnings accrue only as variable interest on your balance.
